description: Verify that TCP in ESTABLISHED enters CLOSED on application ABORT call (RFC 793 §3.9 p62 Event Processing)
approach:
[Objective]
ABORT is an immediate teardown — unlike CLOSE, no FIN handshake. DUT must emit a RST and clean up the socket.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake → ESTABLISHED.
2. Tester (UT) → DUT: ABORT call.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: RST AND DUT in CLOSED (verify-probe replies RST again)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT emits RST after ABORT AND post-ABORT probe also gets RST.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_dut_rst — DUT did not emit RST after ABORT in ESTABLISHED
• Fail_no_verify_rst — DUT did not close

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted RST and closed on ABORT — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_dut_rst: DUT did not emit RST after ABORT in EST
verdicts.Fail_no_verify_rst: DUT did not close after ABORT in EST
